cancelDialog.title: Cancel subscription?
cancelDialog.description: This marks "{{name}}" as cancelled but keeps it in your list and history.

deleteDialog.title: Delete subscription?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently deletes "{{name}}". This can't be undone.

pause.title: Pause subscription?
pause.description: This marks "{{name}}" as paused. It stops counting toward your spending until you resume it.

resume.title: Resume subscription?
resume.description: This sets "{{name}}" back to active, so it counts toward your spending again.

reactivate.title: Reactivate subscription?
reactivate.description: This sets "{{name}}" back to active and clears its cancellation date.
